goal: A wedding planner bot: vendors, budget, guest lists, colors and themes.

jobs.name: Vendor Tracker
jobs.does: Manages your list of vendors and keeps them organized for the wedding
jobs.sample_ask: Who are we planning to hire for catering and photography?

jobs.name: Budget Monitor
jobs.does: Keeps track of your spending limits across all wedding categories
jobs.sample_ask: How much have we spent so far on the reception venue?

jobs.name: Theme Designer
jobs.does: Helps you define and maintain the color palette, ambiance, and overall feel of the event
jobs.sample_ask: What colors and design themes do you want to stick to for the invitations?
